userStories.title: Steady frame and markdown block spacing
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Keep the composed chat frame one terminal row short and separate nonempty top-level markdown blocks by one blank row.

**Motivation** — #2708 — the whole screen blinks on every keystroke, on the working-line tick and while text streams.

**Approach** — **1. Steady frame (US-001, #2708).** `ChatApp` derives every row budget from `usableRows = size.rows - FRAME_SLACK_ROWS` (`FRAME_SLACK_ROWS = 1`) instead of `size.rows`: the bottom budget, the menu, ask-card and picker budgets and the viewport height alike. The composed frame is therefore at most `rows - 1` rows tall in every state — a long draft, an oversized ask card, an open picker or slash menu included — so Ink's `lastOutputHeight >= stdout.rows` branch is never taken and Ink's normal log-update path runs. The footer stays the frame's last row; the terminal's last row stays blank. `renderChat` passes `incrementalRendering: true` (an Ink 6.7 `RenderOptions` field) next to `exitOnCtrlC: false`, so Ink rewrites only the rows that changed.

**2. Block spacing (US-001, #2709).** `renderMarkdown` renders each top-level token with `blockLines` as today, drops the blocks that produced no lines (`space`, `def`, an empty paragraph), and joins the remaining blocks with exactly one empty `StyledLine` (`[]`) between each adjacent pair: none before the first block and none after the last. The gap is independent of the source: `code` immediately followed by a paragraph with no blank source line still gets one blank row. Spacing inside a list (between items, tight or loose) and inside a blockquote is unchanged — only top-level blocks are separated.

**Scope** — In: ChatApp row arithmetic, renderChat's incremental option, top-level markdown joins and corresponding existing layout/markdown/render tests. Out: mouse stream construction/lifecycle and wheel actions (US-002/003), selection/copy (US-004/005), model enumeration/filtering (US-006/007). The Ink version is not changed.

**Interface** — Existing `renderChat(props)` retains its interface and renders with `{ exitOnCtrlC: false, incrementalRendering: true }`; US-003 later adds `stdin`. Existing `renderMarkdown` retains its public signature and returns `readonly StyledLine[]`.

**Regression migration** — Update all full-frame counts in chat-app-layout.test.tsx: default 24→23, 30-row cases including tall draft F1 and ask card 30→29, and 12-row tall draft 12→11; update viewport/input counts where slack falls, preserving header/footer/input/viewport content assertions. In slash-menu.test.tsx change SHORT_ROWS counts to SHORT_ROWS-1, and increase F15/F16 terminal heights by one if needed to preserve the no-menu-row scenario and its key behavior. In index.test.tsx add incrementalRendering to exact options expectations; alt-screen write ordering is unchanged in this story.

renderMarkdown of a blockquote containing multiple nested blocks preserves their existing internal spacing.

modifiedFiles.reason: every assertion that the frame has exactly the terminal's row count changes to that count minus one, because every budget now derives from `usableRows = rows - 1`: the default-stream case (24 becomes 23), the 30-row harness cases including the tall-draft (F1) and ask-card cases (30 becomes 29), and the 12-row tall-draft case (12 becomes 11); an assertion that counts viewport or input rows changes by the same one row where the slack falls on it; every assertion on what the footer, header, input or viewport rows contain is unchanged.

the short-terminal cases that assert `rows` has length `SHORT_ROWS` (12) change to `SHORT_ROWS - 1`, and the F15/F16 cases (a terminal with no rows for the menu) keep their behaviour but move their terminal height up by one row if the one-row slack would otherwise change whether the menu gets a row; the menu-key behaviour each case asserts is unchanged.

the case asserting `render` was called with options equal to `{ exitOnCtrlC: false }` changes its expected options to include `incrementalRendering: true` beside `exitOnCtrlC: false` (US-003 later adds `stdin`); the alt-screen write-order assertions are unchanged in this story.

routing.reasoning: New stream/event abstraction must combine incremental grammar parsing, UTF-8 decoding, terminal control forwarding and listener lifecycle without corrupting keyboard input.

suggestedCriteria: Calling ref() and unref() on the filtered stream forwards each call to the source.
Writing multiple complete SGR reports mixed with typed text in one chunk emits mouse events in report order and yields only the typed text.
parseSgrMouse returns undefined when the string contains a complete report followed by extra text.
Writing horizontal wheel report \u001b[<67;3;4M yields no filtered bytes and no mouse event.
When an incomplete SGR prefix is followed by a chunk that breaks its grammar, the complete malformed text is forwarded unchanged.

analysis:
Enhancement of the existing @nathapp/nax React/Ink chat UI, closing #2708–#2711; not a greenfield rewrite. Navigation: codebase-memory MCP is not exposed in this host, so discovery used direct reads and text searches rooted at the supplied repository. All implementation changes stay in packages/nax. No other package needs modification. Read docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md:15 for the conventions/DI index and :172 for the quick-reference constraints; use existing injectable _deps seams, Bun-native runtime operations, bun:test, ink-testing-library and React act. This planning task does not execute tests or change implementation code.

US-001 baseline and impact: packages/nax/src/tui/chat/ChatApp.tsx:151 applies the 24x80 defaults; :309 derives bottomBudget directly from size.rows; :555 also derives viewportHeight from size.rows. The input, slash menu, ask-card and picker are measured against that budget, and the footer is the final fixed row. Replace both terminal-row roots with usableRows = size.rows - FRAME_SLACK_ROWS (1), not a viewport-only subtraction: long drafts, running turns and oversized bottom surfaces must keep the slack. Preserve existing header/footer/input content and keyboard ownership. packages/nax/src/tui/chat/index.ts:34 owns alternate-screen mounting and :45 currently renders only with exitOnCtrlC:false; add incrementalRendering:true without changing Ink version. packages/nax/src/tui/chat/markdown.ts:273 currently ends by flatMapping blockLines; :213 recursively flattens blockquote children. Add a single [] separator only between nonempty top-level block renderings, leaving list/quote internals and malformed-source fallback intact. packages/nax/src/tui/chat/layout.ts:135 consumes renderMarkdown behind the reply gutter; :350 composes entries and their existing gaps. No extra inter-entry spacing should be introduced. Regression migration: packages/nax/test/ui/chat/chat-app-layout.test.tsx:106 provides mount/resize helpers; update exact full-frame expectations 24→23, 30→29 and 12→11, and affected viewport/input row counts, but not row contents. packages/nax/test/ui/chat/slash-menu.test.tsx:497 covers SHORT_ROWS=12; change full-frame assertions to SHORT_ROWS-1, and shift F15/F16 terminal heights up one if needed to preserve the no-menu-row scenario (:546, :559). packages/nax/test/ui/chat/index.test.tsx:130 expects exact render options and must first gain incrementalRendering, then stdin in US-003. Existing unit markdown, layout and wrap tests under test/unit/tui/chat also cover the rendering consumers.

US-002 architecture: create packages/nax/src/tui/chat/mouse-input.ts as a reusable filtered input stream plus ordered event subscription, independent of React and renderChat wiring. Node-compatible PassThrough and StringDecoder are specifically required by the Ink NodeJS.ReadStream contract; these are not a reason to replace Bun subprocess APIs elsewhere. Preserve source isTTY, setRawMode, ref and unref and the filtered stream's own UTF-8 read encoding. Parse only full SGR reports; hold syntactically incomplete ESC[< tails, but not bare ESC or ESC[. Invalid grammar must pass through rather than swallowing typed input; complete unsupported horizontal-wheel reports must be removed without events. Decoder state matters for split UTF-8. dispose removes the source data listener; unsubscribe removes individual event listeners. Risks: input corruption, Escape latency, report leakage, stale listeners and inaccurate stream methods would break all Ink input. Unit tests use fake sources and never attach to the test runner's stdin.

US-003 integration: packages/nax/src/tui/chat/index.ts:35 writes ENTER_ALT_SCREEN, :38 builds a one-shot restore, :46 registers the removable exit guard, and the catch path already restores on renderer exceptions. Retain exception safety and unmount-before-terminal-restore ordering. Add injected stdin/createMouseInput, pass filtered stdin in render options and events in the ChatApp element, enable reporting only after render returns/raw mode is installed, and disable reporting immediately before leaving the alternate screen (TTY only); dispose exactly once even on process exit. packages/nax/test/ui/chat/index.test.tsx:33 stubScreen must inject both stdin and mouse construction before production uses them; update TTY write-order assertions, non-TTY behavior and render options without opening real input. packages/nax/src/tui/chat/viewport.ts:20 has the action union; :52 settle clamps offsets and resumes follow at zero; :76 reduces actions; :104 exposes visibleRange. Add wheelUp/down through the same clamp with WHEEL_LINES=3. packages/nax/src/tui/chat/TranscriptViewport.tsx:152 owns memory and keyboard activity; subscribe to mouse while active and clean up subscriptions.
